ria: Heads-up: new Next + LlamaIndex starter shows two UX issues during onboarding: JS SDK auth retries differ from Python, and streaming sometimes stalls on Vercel. Both hit new users in the eval harness. Short notes + repro below.

tom: Can you paste the minimal repro?

ria: Repro (local / Vercel preview):
1) clone sample repo, set RW_KEY to ephemeral dev key
2) start dev, open /chat, trigger a streaming chat that calls embeddings + chat sequentially
Observed: JS client returns 401 on embedding call and fails fast (no retry), then the chat stream starts but stops after 1-2 chunks and never closes on Vercel. Python harness retries auth and completes.

fern: Sounds like two regressions: auth-policy mismatch + stream flush optimization. Short-term: enable auth-retry opt-in in JS starter and fall back to non-streaming in serverless CI. Long-term: align SDK defaults and add platform-aware flush.

ops-bot: CI: onboarding run #4215: 3 failing checks (auth-parity, stream-hang). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/4215 :warning:

ria: Action items: tom -> add `retryOnAuthError` opt-in + tests; fern -> add `forceFlush` option for streaming and enable in starter dev config; I'll update README with streaming caveats and repro steps. We'll canary the starter after patches.
